verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Pulumi's license type (e.g., Apache 2.0), its governance model, or any foundation/neutral steward that would prevent unilateral relicensing — only GitHub repo links and generic self-hosting/backend docs. Given the well-known industry concern (post-Terraform BSL) that devops leads would want addressed, this axis clearly applies but no evidence in the pack speaks to license or governance guarantees.
